description: A strip marker removes the line separator U+2028 and paragraph separator U+2029
notes: The spec says strip markers remove spaces, "interpreted as per Unicode's definition", without saying which definition it means. The line separator U+2028 and paragraph separator U+2029 have the White_Space property but are not space separators (category Zs): they are in categories Zl and Zp. Stripping them is hashicorp/hcl's reading: parseTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go trims with Go's unicode.IsSpace, which follows the White_Space property.
